name: usage_counter
description: Append-only tutor message and live-voice usage events for one Parle learner

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the learner who owns this event

period.description: Local usage period used by the server limits service

period_key.description: Learner-local YYYY-MM-DD day or YYYY-MM month computed on the server

ai_messages.description: Server-written count represented by this event; one per accepted learner submission

voice_minutes.description: Server-written live voice minutes represented by this event

source_session_id.description: Tutor session associated with the usage event

source_event_id.description: Server-generated event id used for diagnostics
